mas_config.mas_context: The MAS is designed to generate a follow-up research proposal in a [Question 1]-[Question 5] format by leveraging the expertise and previous work of two authors, Jonathan Frankle and Michael Carbin. Each author writes a proposal candidate based on their research persona, which is then aggregated into a final proposal by the proposal aggregator.
